item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:55 HKT 18/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong today. Troughs of low pressure are expected to affect the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week to early next week. The weather will be unsettled with thundery showers over the region.
